```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, tidy = TRUE)
```

# Load Packages

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(here)
library(ranger)
library(tidymodels)
library(DALEXtra) #Explainer (variable importance, partial dependence, etc)
library(spatialsample) #Use for spatial cross validation

conflicted::conflicts_prefer(yardstick::rmse)
conflicted::conflicts_prefer(dplyr::filter)
```

# Load Data

```{r, results = FALSE}
plots <- st_read(here("data/processed/fuels_analysis.gpkg"), layer = "allplotsDS") #%>%
  #st_drop_geometry()
plots$northness[is.na(plots$northness)] <- 0
plots$eastness[is.na(plots$eastness)] <- 0

plots <- plots %>%
  mutate(across(c("northness", "eastness", "elevation", "slope", "TMAX", "PRCP", "TMIN", "TOTAL_COUNT", "prop_Rearrangement", "prop_Wildfire", "prop_Broadcast.Burn", "prop_Removal", "prop_extent_treated", "TCC", "prop_aspen", "prop_lodgepole", "prop_mixed.conifer", "prop_other", "prop_pinyon.juniper", "prop_ponderosa", "prop_spruce.fir"), as.numeric))


plots_100m <- dplyr::filter(plots, buffer_radius == 100)
plots_250m <- dplyr::filter(plots, buffer_radius == 250)
plots_500m <- dplyr::filter(plots, buffer_radius == 500)

preds <- c("northness", "slope", "PRCP", "TMAX", "prop_extent_treated",  "TCC") #For use later in VIPs

plots_100m %>%
  group_by(Incid_Name) %>%
  summarize(mean(prop_high_sev))
```

# Proportion of High-Severity

## 100m

```{r}
set.seed(123)
data_split_hi100 <- initial_split(plots_100m, strata = "prop_high_sev", prop = 0.80)
hi100_train <- training(data_split_hi100)
hi100_test  <- testing(data_split_hi100)
```

Create a recipe
```{r}
hi100_rec <- recipe(prop_high_sev ~ northness + slope + PRCP + TMAX + prop_extent_treated + TCC, data = hi100_train)

hi100_prep <- prep(hi100_rec)
```

Set up a model specification to tune
```{r}
tune_spec <- rand_forest(mtry = tune(), 
                         trees = 2000,
                         min_n = tune()) %>%
              set_mode("regression") %>%
              set_engine("ranger", importance = "permutation")
```

Set up a workflow
```{r}
tune_wf <- workflow() %>%
  add_recipe(hi100_rec) %>%
  add_model(tune_spec)
```

Tune hyperparameters based on RMSE
```{r}
set.seed(234)

hi100_folds <- spatial_clustering_cv(hi100_train)

# hi100_folds %>% 
#   mutate(held_out_fire = map(splits, ~ assessment(.x) %>% distinct(Incid_Name))) %>% 
#   unnest(held_out_fire) %>% 
#   select(id, Incid_Name)

doParallel::registerDoParallel()
#show_notes(.Last.tune.result)

rf_grid <- grid_regular(
  mtry(range = c(1, 6)),
  min_n(range = c(1,40)),
  levels = 5
)

set.seed(456)
regular_res <- tune_grid(
  tune_wf,
  resamples = hi100_folds,
  grid = rf_grid
)

regular_res %>%
  collect_metrics() %>%
  filter(.metric == "rmse") %>%
  mutate(min_n = factor(min_n)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(mtry, mean, color = min_n)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.5, size = 1.5) +
  geom_point()
```

Select Best Fit
```{r}
best_rmse <- select_best(regular_res, metric = "rmse")
final_workflow <- tune_wf %>%
  finalize_workflow(best_rmse)
```

Evaluate metrics across spatial crossvalidation folds
```{r}
rf_res <- 
    final_workflow %>% 
    fit_resamples(
      resamples = hi100_folds, 
      metrics = metric_set(rmse, rsq),
      control = control_resamples(save_pred = TRUE)
      ) 
  
rf_res %>%  
  collect_metrics(summarize = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(Dataset="training") %>% 
  mutate(Model="RF") 

rf_res %>% 
  collect_metrics(summarize = FALSE) %>% 
  dplyr::filter(.metric == "rmse") 

rf_res %>% 
  collect_metrics(summarize = FALSE) %>% 
  dplyr::filter(.metric == "rsq") 
```

Fit Final Model
```{r}
final_fit <- final_workflow %>%
  last_fit(data_split_hi100)

collect_metrics(final_fit)      # test-set RMSE, R², etc.
hi100_predictions <- collect_predictions(final_fit)  # observed vs. predicted on the held-out test set
ggplot(hi100_predictions, aes(prop_high_sev, .pred)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.25)+
  geom_abline(linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "black") +
  labs(
    x = "Observed",
    y = "Predicted",
    color = NULL,
    title = "Observed vs. Predicted Proportion of High Severity Fire, 100 m"
  )

final_fitted <- final_fit$.workflow[[1]]
final_fitted
```

Explainer
```{r}
hi100_explainer <- explain_tidymodels(
  final_fitted,
  data = hi100_train %>% st_drop_geometry() %>% dplyr::select(all_of(preds), Incid_Name),
  y = hi100_train$prop_high_sev,
  verbose = FALSE
)
```

Variable Importance Plot 
```{r}
# Variable Importance Plots
vip_hi100 <- variable_importance(hi100_explainer,
                                variables = preds)
plot(vip_hi100) 
```

PDP
```{r}
pdp_hi100 <- model_profile(
  hi100_explainer,
  variables = "prop_extent_treated",
  N = NULL
)
plot(pdp_hi100)
```

Shaply Plot - just for fun
```{r}
shap_plots <- predict_parts(hi100_explainer, hi100_test[96, ], type = 'shap')
plot(shap_plots)
```

```{r}
  geom_abline(linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "black") +
  labs(
    x = "Observed",
    y = "Predicted",
    color = NULL,
```
```{r}
    title = "Observed vs. Predicted Proportion of Moderate to High Severity Fire, 500 m"
  )

final_fitted <- final_fit$.workflow[[1]]
final_fitted
```

# Average reduction in percent area burned at high severity between 0 and 1 treated area

```{r}
trt_effect <- function(explainer) {
  dat <- explainer$data

  d0 <- dat; d0$prop_extent_treated <- 0   # untreated
  d1 <- dat; d1$prop_extent_treated <- 1   # fully treated

  p0 <- predict(explainer$model, new_data = d0)$.pred
  p1 <- predict(explainer$model, new_data = d1)$.pred

  tibble::tibble(
    mean_pred_untreated = mean(p0),
    mean_pred_treated   = mean(p1),
    abs_diff            = mean(p1) - mean(p0),                 # in proportion units
    pct_diff            = (mean(p1) - mean(p0)) / mean(p0) * 100  # relative % change
  )
}

results <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  "High sev, 100m"   = trt_effect(hi100_explainer),
  "High sev, 250m"   = trt_effect(hi250_explainer),
  "High sev, 500m"   = trt_effect(hi500_explainer),
  "Mod-high, 100m"   = trt_effect(mohi100_explainer),
  "Mod-high, 250m"   = trt_effect(mohi250_explainer),
  "Mod-high, 500m"   = trt_effect(mohi500_explainer),
  .id = "model"
)
results
mean(results$pct_diff)
```

# Visualizing the difference between using spatial_block_cv and spatial_clustering_cv

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(spatialsample)
library(tigris)

set.seed(123)
hi100_block <- spatial_block_cv(hi100_train)
hi100_clust <- spatial_clustering_cv(hi100_train)

# One row per observation, labeled with the fold where it's held out
fold_assignments <- function(rset) {
  map2_dfr(rset$splits, rset$id, ~ assessment(.x) |> mutate(fold = .y))
}

folds_df <- bind_rows(
  fold_assignments(hi100_block) |> mutate(method = "Spatial block CV"),
  fold_assignments(hi100_clust) |> mutate(method = "Spatial clustering CV")
)

# Colorado outline, matched to your data's CRS
co <- states(cb = TRUE, progress_bar = FALSE) |>
  filter(NAME == "Colorado") |>
  st_transform(st_crs(hi100_train))

ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = co, fill = "grey95", color = "grey40") +
  geom_sf(data = folds_df, aes(color = fold), size = 0.8, alpha = 0.8) +
  facet_wrap(~ method) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Paired") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(color = "Fold")

folds_df |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  count(method, fold) |>
  ggplot(aes(fold, n, fill = method)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  theme_minimal()

autoplot(hi100_block)
autoplot(hi100_clust)
```
